title: P104: stationary primal/dual composition with 167 CLEAR certificates (conditional κ 0.003661102618151)
body:
## Contribution and scope
Stationary primal/dual bypass composition, fixed 167-CLEAR checkpoint. Conditional signed κ = 0.003661102618151; native ingredient κ = 0.003660347316298. Not an unconditional theorem, selected-frontier update, practical speedup or maintainer acceptance.

26 files exclusively under research/p104-stationary-primal-dual, based on main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Scope refined: p104-side-correction, see TASK.json. No existing research package or shared checker changed. Later 173-CLEAR research checkpoint is not covered.

## Provenance and overlap
Builds on SYLforge #7616, adding 532/1464 and 226/990 funded-return/courier moves, tight auxiliary lifetimes and stationary primal/dual bypasses. Couriers overlap DreamingOfClouds #7617 and earlier #7615; no exclusive novelty or priority claim for them. Full composition has 167 = 74 original + 93 added CLEAR lifetimes, 54 more than #7616. #7618 is separate gate tooling and #7619 separate findings; their changes are not incorporated or claimed here.

Candidate generation was performed in Antigravity. Independent snapshot verification, adaptation and integration used OpenAI assistance. #7616 itself composes #7605 (Ali Romman/Codex), #7611 (DreamingOfClouds/Claude), #7612 (Clear1nsight/OpenAI). Retain #7603, Hao Yan/FanPUYen, ToikY, Rohan Arun, dillona, CubeJerry and all nested-source authors and Apache-2.0 notices.

## Validation
Full candidate-adapted native and signed applications passed: 3093 catalogue cases and assembly, finite physical replay, fresh grid/envelope and fixed-tape checks. 837 affected chart pairs across 160 public fields each receive 512 forward + 512 adjoint Gaussian column checks, rank/absolute phase and wrong-phase controls. All 167 exact CLEAR certificates pass, including coefficient and wrong-field rejection controls.

Paid 110145; productive 22461; ordinary 788917744 < 1e9; precision 2430. Original 195 owned events retain order; peak 50, declared labels 68, fixed allocation 17*68=1156 banks. Tape: 44233824 scalar services, 25413787840 elementary records.

504 word reconstruction splices are not 504 checker relaxations. Expected hashes, complete affected-pair census, invoice and price probes are explicitly adapted; negative controls are retained. Exact runners, adapter records, audit, logs, receipts and package hashes included. No original-unmodified acceptance, Linux run or hosted CI pass claimed.

## Remaining premises
native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery. Algebraic CLEAR certificates and lifetime accounting do not themselves implement universal erasure/compiler services. These premises still require independent review.

## Reproduction
Python 3.12, assertions enabled. Supply immutable #7616 package at 22b310ba50a554b6111804824782793beb41073f and #7605 source at e1d2756eecf03e146338239fee81772a99ba8d4c:

    python reproduce.py --w2 /path/to/p104-w2-stationary-followup --source /path/to/p104-timed-helper757 --work /short/new-work --stage all
    python verify_certificates.py data/word.json.gz evidence/certs.json

Registered VERIFY covers exact CLEAR certificates only; full replay requires authenticated source closure. Portable preparation reproduces tested runner bytes. Windows path normalization is explicit and hash-pinned; originals unchanged.

Pinned compressed word SHA256: 2eb2cf1d29529c68a6cb1c0639de3065a805858d3492068e76b70c5a5e80a81c. See README, PINS, BASE-NOTICE and evidence for full scope.

## Open next questions
Independently reproduce the pinned full application, review adapter substitutions and the five remaining framework premises. Exact algebraic checks alone are not independent human acceptance.
